title: I accidentially realease the game instead of the demo with almost no wishlists..
author: FlimsyReality4086
selftext:
Hey there,

I wanted to release the DEMO for my game on Steam but didnt pay attention to which APP Id I was working in and released my full game before I actually wanted to.

The reason I wanted to wait is, because I wanted to gather feedback through a demo for all people to try. But somehow (I really dont know how) with maybe only 10 wishlists i ust sold 3 copies within releasing like 5 hours ago. Initially I wanted to draw back the release via support but now I feel bad for the people who bought it already if it would get refunded for them.

The game is a full game already but i just wanted to do minor improvements and fixes from demo testing feedback.

Did something like his happen to anyone else? What to do now?

Thanks a lot.

comments.author: LimeBlossom_TTV
comments.body: Contact support.  Don't feel bad, the purchasers will probably appreciate getting the full game instead.

replies.author: FlimsyReality4086
replies.body: yeah might be best if i just do that..thanks

replies.author: devpottt
replies.body: I think it will trigger refunds and bad reviews maybe..

replies.author: FlimsyReality4086
replies.body: I don't really feel that. Would be bad for the buyers o think.

comments.author: Bavariasnaps
comments.body: You skipped your own marketing campagin. I would remove it.

replies.author: FlimsyReality4086
replies.body: thats exaclty what i thought 😞 i cant set it back just like that but will ask steam so move it back so "coming soon" i guess. Thanks.

replies.author: FlimsyReality4086
replies.body: Yeah 😅 my takeaway is always pay attention when you press "the" button and double triple check...

comments.author: TriumphantConch
comments.body: The bright side is you legit got sales though 😆

replies.author: FlimsyReality4086
replies.body: Yeah I was surprised bec i had almost no wishlists at all 😅

comments.body: Even by accident, thats one darn good wishlist:sale ratio!

comments.author: PsychoticLab
comments.body: You didn't get review bombed for the AI disclosure so there is that.

comments.author: TianlanLong
comments.body: Yea just talk with support, I think they can take refunds so you can remove it and release again in normal ways

comments.author: Careful-Marzipan8614
comments.body: If I may ask, how did you get the few wishlists you had?
